name: TimeHole
tagline: A network-level focus filter: a DNS server and web proxy that block traffic against goals you describe in words.

awards: Arista Networks: Connect the Dots Challenge

problem: App and browser blockers are easy to bypass and too coarse.
solution: A DNS relay blocks clearly distracting domains; an SSL-capable proxy inspects requests, and a small language model judges whether each one fits the user's stated goals, with detailed logs.
demo_moment: Team-described: set a focus goal and see an off-task page intercepted.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Arista Networks: Connect the Dots Challenge” among 307 submissions.
Applies networking infrastructure to a personal problem, as the challenge asked.

lessons: Read the sponsor brief literally and build at the layer they know.
